label: late "b" input in sequences starting with "a" (very sparse)
explanation: Extremely sparse (29 of 1M sequences, 17 dev steps). Every activation is in the original phase, at orig positions 5-8, in a sequence whose first token is a; 13/17 dev activations (91% of mass) have input b, a few on x/s/q. Never fires at the delimiter or in the copy phase, nor at t<5. Magnitude is largest when b follows z (and f two steps back, e.g. a u o i f z b), i.e. the late a...z b context; but the predicate first_tok=a & input b & t>=5 has only ~1.4% precision, so the feature is a highly specific conjunction that is too rare to characterize reliably.
